assessment_snapshot.intro: The workspace is an empty Git repository with no application files or existing UI to preserve. The request specifies a new product CRUD app with:
bullets: Next.js, React-Bootstrap, built-in routing, Axios, Redux Toolkit, Formik, and Yup
json-server as the product data API; framework and library versions are not stated
No screenshots, design tokens, API contract, or legacy data source are present

proposed_outcome: Create a new Next.js application with a responsive product-management interface, product create/read/update/delete flows, validated forms, Redux Toolkit state, Axios API calls, and a json-server data source. Preserve the requested technologies while confirming versions, UX/design expectations, and data/API assumptions before implementation.
